verses.text: O God, hasten to deliver me; O LORD, hasten to my help!
Let those be ashamed and humiliated Who seek my life; Let those be turned back and dishonored Who delight in my hurt.
Let all who seek Thee rejoice and be glad in Thee; And let those who love Thy salvation say continually, “Let God be magnified.”
But I am afflicted and needy; Hasten to me, O God! Thou art my help and my deliverer; O LORD, do not delay.
